frame.name: Area Denial Frame
frame.description: Burst fire Grenade Launcher. Each projectile creates a lingering pool on impact that deals damage over time.

origins.name: Heretical Behavior
origins.description: Sustained weapon damage or final blows versus powerful targets grant this weapon bonus reload, handling, and damage versus combatants. Gain this bonus immediately for a longer duration when you are revived.

origins.name: Willing Vessel
origins.description: Dealing damage or defeating targets with this weapon gradually grants increased stability, handling, reload speed, and charge rate. This effect gradually decreases over time but is gained more quickly while near allies.

perks.name: Proximity Grenades
perks.description: Grenades fired from this weapon have increased proximity detection but a decreased blast radius.

enhanced.name: Proximity Grenades
enhanced.description: Grenades fired from this weapon have increased proximity detection but a decreased blast radius.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

enhanced.name: Envious Assassin
enhanced.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers additional ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.description:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.

enhanced.name: Rolling Storm
enhanced.description:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge. 
Gain increased Bolt Charge stacks when you have none.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

enhanced.name: Ambitious Assassin
enhanced.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid final blows before reloading. Improves reload.

perks.name: Impromptu Ammunition
perks.description: Final blows increase ammo meter progress from all sources for a short time.

enhanced.name: Impromptu Ammunition
enhanced.description: Final blows increase ammo meter progress from all sources for a slightly increased duration.

perks.name: Blast Distributor
perks.description: Dealing splash damage grants a bonus to Grenade stat.

enhanced.name: Blast Distributor
enhanced.description: Dealing splash damage grants an improved bonus to Grenade stat.

enhanced.name: Auto-Loading Holster
enhanced.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after an improved short period of time.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

enhanced.name: Voltshot
enhanced.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for an improved short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

perks.name: Harmony

enhanced.name: Harmony

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

enhanced.name: Attrition Orbs

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

enhanced.name: Sword Logic
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Gear Shift
perks.description: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.

enhanced.name: Gear Shift
enhanced.description: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a longer period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Elemental Honing
enhanced.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus for an improved duration. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.

enhanced.name: Aggregate Charge
